note: The NV index dataSize field is read from the input TPM2_NV_DefineSpace command and becomes the size used for an orderly RAM-backed NV index.
The input-controlled dataSize is combined with the NV_RAM_HEADER size to compute how many bytes the new orderly RAM entry will occupy.

The space check allows an entry whose header plus data exactly consumes the entire s_indexOrderlyRam array, but it does not reserve space for the zero-size list terminator that later code assumes exists.
The accepted dataSize is stored as the complete entry size; for this candidate it advances the list offset to the end of the 512-byte array.
Because the entry fills the array, this guard is false and no zero-size terminator is written after the entry.
During persistent state marshalling, the loop continues after the full-size entry because termination depends on reading a subsequent zero-size header.
After offset has advanced to array_size, nrhp points one past s_indexOrderlyRam and the memcpy reads a UINT32 header outside the 512-byte array.
